title: Exit Load Factor Scale - C&I Exit Damages
content:
## Contract exits: exit load factor (Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts)

The exit damages rate is scaled by the exit load factor, the exit annual kWh divided by the product of the capacity tag on the most recently posted capacity charge line and 8760 hours per year: 0.65 or more scales it by 0.92, 0.45 up to below 0.65 scales it by 0.96, and a lower load factor, or no capacity charge line, leaves it unscaled. Scaling multiplies the exit damages rate per kWh by the figure shown.

The capacity tag is the tag in kW shown on the contract's capacity charge line with the latest posted date. The exit annual kWh are those of the exit damages being billed.

| Exit load factor | Exit damages rate multiplied by |
|---|---|
| 0.65 or more | 0.92 |
| 0.45 to below 0.65 | 0.96 |
| below 0.45 | 1, unscaled |
| no capacity charge line on the contract | 1, unscaled |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Exit annual kWh | Capacity tag | Tag multiplied by 8760 | Exit load factor | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2847000 | 500 kW | 4380000 | 0.65 | 0.92 |
| 1971000 | 500 kW | 4380000 | 0.45 | 0.96 |
| 1752000 | 500 kW | 4380000 | 0.40 | 1 |
| 1980000 | no capacity charge line | none | none | 1 |
